name: Tandoori Paneer Quesadilla Bites
classification_note: Appetizer per the founder candidate list; shares paneer, hari and raita with the approved Paneer Tikka Taco (cross-utilization).
cooking_method: Marinate, griddle paneer; press quesadilla on a hot comal; cut in 8 triangles

portion.construction: folded half-moon quesadilla pressed, cut in 8

steps: Marinate paneer 2-4 h at ≤ 4 °C (acid ≤ 30 min per paneer texture note).
Sear paneer on a very hot comal until charred spots form.
Fill tortilla with oaxaca and paneer, press 2-3 min per side until crisp and melted.
Rest 30 s, cut in 8, plate with dips.

plating: Black stoneware plate, triangles fanned, dips in two small bowls, pickled onion heap.
